cohort: Postpartum women aged 12-55 years with at least one delivery, continuously enrolled in Texas Medicaid from 84 days before to 12 months after delivery, and who initiated an antidepressant within 90 days postpartum.
finding: Overall antidepressant adherence and persistence among postpartum women in Texas Medicaid were suboptimal, with increasing age, non-Black race, urban residence, more postpartum care visits, and baseline depression/anxiety associated with higher adherence, while baseline SUD and preterm birth were associated with lower adherence.
